title: “THE DIAPASON OF POSSIBLE CONCERNS, BEHAVIORAL ATTRIBUTES, OR SYSTEMS OF ‘GAIA’”

lists.name: THE DIAPASON OF POSSIBLE CONCERNS, BEHAVIORAL ATTRIBUTES, OR SYSTEMS OF ‘GAIA’
lists.of: possible concerns, behavioral attributes, or systems of ‘Gaia’
items: Acceleration of evolution or enhancement of natural selection
Active—even exploratory or experimental—‘sensory’ monitoring of the local or global PHYSICAL environment?
Any form or degree of quasi-mental faculties (purpose, intelligence, planning, thought, learning, self-awareness, consciousness, or the like)?
Efficient resource-allocation (over all competing organisms—for the sake of the general good or Gaia)?

Insulation or isolation of the bios [e.g. by enlarging or changing the atmosphere, creating atmospheric sublayers or aerosols, laying a chemical or biological film over the ocean, or self-sealing biological communities]?
Interspecific—even pan-taxonic—role-specialization and delegation of responsibility
Local—even global—communication between all organisms (of ‘Gaian’ messages for Gaian purposes)?
Local—even global—government by all (?) species over one another?
Maintenance (e.g. of systems, states, or the status quo)

Maximization [e.g. of resources, redundancy, phenes, biological communities, species, taxa, energy, homeostasis, safety, reliability, invariance, standardization, control over the geosphere, control over evolution, control over ‘chance’ (at all physical levels), invariance, cooperation, integration, bionts, life activities, earth’s fertility or hospitality to life, cybernetic linkages or systems, efficiency, biomass, surface structures, ‘miniaturization’, qualitative dimensions of life, lebensraum, biological or bios laws, biological organization, biological information, negentropy, order, or symmetry, speed of biological processes, hierarchical levels, and/or the like]?
Monitoring of the ‘CHRONOLOGICAL environment’ [of long or short term temporal regularities or irregularities—cycles, trends, or events]?
Passive or active monitoring of the local or global BIOLOGICAL environment?
Passive ‘sensory’ monitoring of the local—even global—PHYSICAL environment?
‘Play’ (incl. the equivalent of play on the level and part of the bios)?

Policing interactions of organisms or even intra-organismal systems [incl. species, taxa, kingdoms, ecosystems, organs, cells, organelles, microorganisms, viruses, viroids, or epidemics; by ‘keeping the peace’, resolving conflict, catching offenders, punishing or exterminating offenders, passing, modifying, or deleting ‘laws’, ‘directing traffic’, etc]?
Progressive biological investment and control of the ‘geosphere’ (earth’s nonbiological phenomena in toto)?
Progressive COMBINABILITY of progressively larger—or fundamental—biological systems?
Progressive EVOLVABILITY of progressively larger—or fundamental—biological systems?
Progressive PERMUTABILITY of progressively larger—or fundamental—biological systems?
Progressive TRANSFORMABILITY of progressively larger—or fundamental—biological systems?
‘Representing the will’ of the majority of earth’s organisms?
‘Rules of ecological conduct’ (of bionts, populations, species, taxa, communities, or ecosystems)
Storage of materials (in vivo or ex vivo) or organisms
Suppressing aberrant or pathological organisms or biological phenomena?
‘Teaching, training, or enculturating’ all earth’s organisms or organic systems?

notes:
by Patrick Gunkel
FOREWORD: Items that are extremely speculative end with a question mark. Though large, the present list is certainly incomplete. The list’s concern is clearly limited to general categories of possibilities. The purpose of the list is to stimulate thought, discussion, experimental investigation, and criticism of the revolutionary Gaia Hypothesis of James Lovelock.
